title: interview-ui round (v1)
description: One round of an agent-driven interview, written by the agent to `<interview-dir>/rounds/round-NN.json` and rendered by the `interview-ui` shell as a full-screen decision form. Decisions are grouped; each decision carries the context the agent already knows, an optional explainer document (Markdown with Mermaid, or HTML), and options with their consequences. The browser answers with an `interview-answers.v1` payload.

round.description: 1-based round number. Must match the `NN` in the filename (`round-01.json` → 1).

slug.description: Stable kebab-case id for the whole interview. The shell keys browser drafts on it; the agent uses it as the interview directory name.

title.description: Human title shown in the header, e.g. `Order tags — spec interview`.

skill.description: Skill that is running the interview (`create-spec`, `plan-feature`, …). Display only.

kind.description: `questions` (default) renders decisions one per screen. `readback` additionally renders `summary` first — use it for the final "anything I got wrong before I draft?" round.

intro.description: Markdown shown above the first decision — what this round is about, what changed since the last one.

summary.description: Markdown read-back of every load-bearing decision so far. Rendered only when `kind` is `readback`.

replies.description: Agent answers to questions the user asked in earlier rounds (`interview-answers.v1` → `questions[]`). Shown next to the decision they refer to, or in the general panel when `decision_id` is absent.

question_id.description: `questions[].id` from the answers payload being replied to.

decision_id.description: Decision the question was about. Omit for general questions.

groups.description: Ordered groups (the left rail). For `create-spec` these are its interview groups A–I.

explainer.description: Rich explanation. Either inline Markdown (string or `{markdown}`) or a file under `<interview-dir>/docs/` (`{path}`). `.md` files render in the shell with Mermaid support; `.html` files render in a sandboxed iframe for layouts Markdown cannot express.

path.description: Relative to the interview dir, inside `docs/` (e.g. `docs/D4-concurrency.md`). The server refuses anything that escapes `docs/`.

value.description: Stable machine value echoed back in `answers[].values`.

label.description: Short card title, a few words.

description.description: One or two sentences: what this option is.

consequences.description: What picking this implies downstream — a new plan phase, a one-way door, a dependency, a cost. The "choose wisely" line.

recommended.description: Marks the agent's recommended default. At most one per decision.

tags.description: Small pills under the card, e.g. `{label: "One-way door", tone: "warn"}`.

id.description: Stable id within the interview (e.g. `D4`). Reused across rounds when a decision is re-asked.

title.description: The question, as a full sentence the user can answer.

why.description: One sentence on why the answer matters (the `*Why:*` line from the create-spec question bank).

context.description: Markdown: what the agent already knows that bears on this decision — earlier answers quoted back, repo facts, constraints. Mermaid fences allowed.

required.description: When `false`, the round can be submitted with this decision left open. Default `true`.

waivable.description: Show the "not applicable — skip" toggle. Default `true`.

type.description: `single` — pick one option; `multi` — pick any; `text` — free-form answer; `confirm` — like `single`, for yes/no and read-back confirmations.

allow_other.description: Adds a "Something else" card with a text field. Default: on when `options` is empty, off otherwise.

placeholder.description: `text` input only — placeholder with a real example answer.
